name: Meteoric-Sanctum
description: An ocean of dust without banks. At the edge of sight, past impact-scarred wastelands, mirage-cities rise and collapse by noon, and the light turns brutal and white.

Standing still, you feel the hot air press in like a verdict. Wind is the only voice here, and it repeats itself. The only confirmed life is microbial, a chemosynthetic film that glows faintly where the ground weeps warmth.
The oldest impact basin predates the system's estimated age by a comfortable margin. The survey bureau has quietly stopped publishing the numbers.
Every syndicate scout files the same advice: harvest fast, land light, and never spend a full cycle planetside. The wise ones follow it exactly once.
